spec.expr:
sum by (service) (
  rate(
    http_requests_total{
      service!="",
      handler!="/metrics",
      handler!="/health",
      handler!="/health/live",
      handler!="/health/ready",
      handler!="/health/startup",
      handler!="/docs",
      handler!="/openapi.json"
    }[5m]
  )
)

spec.title: P95 Request Latency
spec.description: 95th percentile application request latency by service, excluding health, docs, OpenAPI, and metrics traffic.

spec.expr:
sum by (handler) (
  rate(
    http_request_duration_seconds_count{
      service="asset-service",
      handler!="/metrics",
      handler!="/docs",
      handler!="/openapi.json",
      handler!="/health",
      handler!="/health/live",
      handler!="/health/ready",
      handler!="/health/startup"
    }[5m]
  )
)
